reason: Not a TypeKit bug: the MVC [FromBody] T v of a class is nullable, so ASP.NET makes the body optional, and its OpenAPI 2.0 writer turns any nullable body into allOf:[{x-nullable:true}] without pattern; a plain int? without TypeKit gets the same bytes. The harness compared a nullable class value object with a non-nullable int (fix-f2-g1-openapi, measured at 1ee02fc).
